# Eave — Home upkeep without the overwhelm

> Eave (eavehome.app) is a personal home management app. It is the home's
> memory: owners set up from the paperwork they already have, capture anything
> by text, voice, or photo, and Eave keeps the record, schedules the upkeep,
> and says what needs doing this week and why.

## What Eave does (as of September 2026)

- Intelligent Home Setup: drop in the closing folder, utility bills, manuals,
  or an inspection report; Eave reads them and files what it finds. Confident
  finds are filed with an undo on each; uncertain ones wait for review.
  Eight resumable steps, reachable later from Property settings. Nothing
  shows as overdue in a home's first 90 days.
- Capture: type a note and Eave builds the record (free on every plan). With
  Eave Intelligence, speak it or snap a photo and Eave drafts the record from
  what it hears or sees.
- Home record: Spaces, Structure (roof, foundation, windows, doors, siding,
  chimney, gutters, fences, decks, insulation), Systems (HVAC, water heater,
  electrical panel, plumbing, sewer/septic, solar, generator, security, AV,
  lighting, network, irrigation, fire and life safety, water treatment,
  EV charging, pool equipment, sump pump), Appliances with warranties and
  service history, Tools and materials, Documents.
- Utilities and services: who serves the address, found from the address or
  read from a photo of a bill; recurring services, insurance, HOA and
  property manager, each with its next date (renewal, expiry, visit,
  inspection). Documents suggest their providers.
- Documents: files up to 100 MB, stored privately, served through links that
  only work for the owner and the people they share with; deleting a
  document erases the file. Storage: 1 GB on Free, 10 GB on Intelligence.
- Home page: one ranked list of what needs you this week with the reason,
  mark done with undo, a calm board for the rest.
- Upkeep Score: a free 0–100 score. Maintenance done on time counts most,
  then backlog health, then readiness. Adding tasks can never lower it.
- Household sharing: invite a co-owner, a helper, or a time-boxed house
  sitter. No per-person charge.
- Connected sources: Gmail and Google Calendar today, plus an .ics feed;
  Outlook, store accounts, and smart-home connections are coming. Everything
  found is reviewed by the owner before it saves.
- Partners: real-estate agents keep a client book, fund a client's
  Intelligence seat ($2.99/seat/month), and stay named in the client's app.
  When funding ends the client keeps Intelligence for 30 days, then chooses.
  Eave never pays referral fees or shares commissions.

## Pricing

- Eave Free: $0 forever, one property, works in any browser at
  https://app.eavehome.app — capture by typing, projects, tasks, spaces,
  structure, systems and appliances, budget tracking, contractors,
  documents (1 GB), Upkeep Score, household sharing, full export.
- Eave Intelligence: $2.99/month ($24/year) — voice capture and photo
  reading, AI project queue, 12-month upkeep plan, guided project plans,
  Equipment Watch and manufacturer lookups, materials estimates and vendor
  research, reading any document, 10 GB document storage.
- Eave Guardian: $24.99/month ($199/year), coming soon — active protection
  with an evidence vault, one-tap insurance and warranty claim packets, a
  10-year capex forecast, and an annual virtual audit review.
- Eave Multi-Property: an add-on to Eave Intelligence covering 2–5 properties, $4.99/month or $39/year ($7.99/month or $63/year with
  Intelligence). Portfolio (6+ properties) is coming; waitlist on the landlords
  page.
- Eave Pro: professional services starting with licensed Home Audits
  ($499–$799 one-time by home size); seasonal coordination and full home
  management are on the waitlist.

## Facts

- Platform: web app live at https://app.eavehome.app; native iOS and Android
  apps coming soon.
- Data policy: connected-source imports are reviewed by the owner before
  anything saves. Documents and photos are private. Export at every plan.
- Company: Limbic Ventures. Support: support@eavehome.app.

## Key pages

- https://eavehome.app/ — the homepage: every stage of a property, without the overwhelm. A timeline of the property’s life whose stages are doors into the app (looking · offer or under contract · just got the keys · lived here a while · getting ready to sell · selling and buying · agent · building), what Eave is and why it’s called Eave, Residential Upkeep, Commercial Upkeep with its five editions, the three seats of a transaction (seller, agent, buyer), Escrow Desk, the engine, the record that transfers, pricing for all five products, and the founder’s story
- https://eavehome.app/pricing — full pricing: Free, Guardian, Intelligence, Multi-Property & Eave Pro
## Products (two families)
Property upkeep: keep a property up.
- https://eavehome.app/residential — Residential Upkeep (Eave Residential): the homeowner app in depth — capture, home memory, intelligence, upkeep plan, and pricing
- https://eavehome.app/commercial — Commercial Upkeep (Eave Commercial): editions for businesses, HOAs/condos, churches/nonprofits, and small multifamily (waitlist)
Property transactions: get through a sale, on either side.
- https://eavehome.app/buyers — Eave for Buyers: the pre-close product. Line up candidate homes, see the facts a listing leaves out (sourced and dated), read the seller’s documents into decisions, compare on the all-in range, run escrow with version control, close into a home that is already set up. $3.99/mo per search for the whole process (hunt through escrow) · $19.99 conversion at close on either plan · $39.99 upfront until it closes, escrow activation included · $10.99 one-time escrow activation per home under contract (launch price); up to 30 homes per search, 2 reads per home in the hunt, 10 in escrow; agent-paid or buyer-paid; free try on 3 homes
- https://eavehome.app/sellers — Eave for Sellers: get a home ready to sell and hand the buyer its record. Capture every fix the agent and inspector mention, a prep list ranked by value and effort (Residential Upkeep: free, or Intelligence $2.99/mo; an agent can cover it with a $2.99 seat), documents and systems in order, and the home record (systems, service history, projects, contractors, documents) transferred to the buyer when the seller chooses. Listing side of Escrow Desk: the agent turns it on at acceptance for a timeline of what the seller owes and the buyer’s dates, from the executed agreement ($10.99 escrow activation, same as buyers); offers grid, repair-request view, and the seller’s own timeline page coming. Agents can add pre-listing starter tasks (curb appeal, quick value, must-fix before showings)
- https://eavehome.app/partners — Eave Partners, for real estate agents: a free console for the whole client book (Needs you, Searches, team); buyer searches from first showing to close; Escrow Desk, turned on per home under contract for a one-time $10.99 escrow activation per side at launch price, the same price whether the buyer or the agent pays (shared escrow timeline from the executed agreement that moves with extensions, client timeline and calendar, every document version with what changed, send for review with read receipts, a digest of what the documents say; first activation free per new firm; included in the $39.99 paid-once search); client seats $2.99/client/mo; Eave Leads in a closed pilot; flat pricing, never a commission cut. Home inspectors: coming soon.
Add-ons to Residential Upkeep: Guardian (coming soon), Pro (home concierge).

## Features (the engine under every product)
One engine runs under Residential, Commercial, Buyers, Sellers, and Partners. Each capability has its own page.
- https://eavehome.app/features — the capability hub: which capability powers which product, and one receipt followed through the whole engine
Bring it in:
- https://eavehome.app/features/connected-sources — Sources: Gmail (read-only receipt and order scan), receipt photos, Amazon order-history import, pro profiles from Thumbtack/Angi/Yelp/Houzz, SmartThings device import, upkeep tasks to Google Calendar or .ics; things you hand over (inspection, manuals, policies, business cards, room photos); public property data pulled automatically
- https://eavehome.app/features/capture — Capture and automatic project building: say it, snap it, or type it; Eave fills room, category, priority, and cost, then builds a plan; guided plans for five kinds of project (fix, install, maintain, hire, plan) on Intelligence
- https://eavehome.app/features/documents — Document intelligence: 46 kinds of property document recognized on upload, 10 readers, facts filed where they belong, every version kept with what changed, "Needs a decision" when two sources disagree
- https://eavehome.app/features/setup — Intelligent Home Setup: set up a home from its paperwork (closing folder, bills, manuals, inspection)
Know the home:
- https://eavehome.app/features/home-knowledge-base — Home knowledge graph: one connected record per property (spaces, structure, systems, appliances, utilities, services, documents, projects, contractors), a house manual for tenants and sitters, full export, and hand-off to a buyer
- https://eavehome.app/features/product-knowledge — Product knowledge graph: a shared library of what manufacturers say about specific models (maintenance schedules, known issues by age, parts), used for model-specific upkeep
- https://eavehome.app/features/place — Place intelligence: flood, fire, seismic, soil, air, school district boundaries, utilities, broadband, and tax for any address, each with its source; never ratings of an area or its schools
Decide what's next:
- https://eavehome.app/features/intelligence — Plans and priorities: the Upkeep Score, this week's ranked list with reasons, the season ahead, and the 12-month Upkeep Plan (Eave Intelligence)
- https://eavehome.app/features/upkeep-score — the live 0–100 home upkeep score, in depth
- https://eavehome.app/features/diy-or-pro — DIY or pro: do it yourself, learn how, or hire it out; materials estimates, tutorials picked for the job, local pro search, and a quote tracker

- https://eavehome.app/features/guardian — evidence vault, claim packets, capex forecast, protection tier (coming soon)
- https://eavehome.app/pro — Eave Pro: concierge home services (licensed Home Audit $499–$799, Audit+Guardian bundle, Seasonal Manager waitlist)
- https://eavehome.app/for/new-homeowners — for first-time / new homeowners
- https://eavehome.app/for/home-buyers — buying a home: turn the inspection into a prioritized plan, understand true cost of ownership, move in already set up
- https://eavehome.app/for/landlords — multi-property owners and landlords
